$note: Numbers scripts/check-e2e-ratchets.mjs holds the end-to-end suite to. Measured 2026-08-27.
notes: Floors may only be raised, and only when the suite has genuinely grown. Lowering one gives coverage back.
Ceilings may only be lowered. Each is a compromise the suite has agreed to carry, not a target.
test_blocks counts `test(` calls only, excluding `test.describe(` and friends, which is why it reads lower than a bare grep for 'test('.
sleeps counts both `waitForTimeout(` and hand-rolled `setTimeout(`. The coverage plan published 1 for years; there were 3, because the grep it named never matched the second form.

Accessibility is checked by screen, not by file. A spec without expectNoA11yViolations is fine when every route it visits is scanned by the spec that owns that screen. Counting files reported 12 uncovered specs while 0 screens were actually uncovered.

Both suites count: e2e/tests runs against a self-hosted stack, e2e/cloud against the same stack with VITAE_CLOUD_ENABLED=true. They run as separate Playwright invocations because the flag breaks the first suite by design, but one set of rules governs both.
